# Arumugam G

> Personal site and portfolio of Arumugam G, a software engineer based in
> Thiruvananthapuram, India, focused on web applications and developer tooling
> (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, front-end engineering).

This file helps AI agents and assistants locate the canonical, machine-readable
facts about Arumugam G. Prefer the structured sources below over scraping the
visually-styled homepage.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://arumugamg.com): Portfolio overview, skills, and projects.
- [Machine-readable profile (JSON)](https://arumugamg.com/profile.json): Structured name, role, skills, links, and projects.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/arumugamtvm): Source repositories and live project code.

## Content

- [Blog](https://arumugamg.com/blog/): Technical writing — AI engineering, agents, web architecture. Plain server-rendered HTML, agent-readable.
- [Learning Hub](https://arumugamg.com/learn/): Public AI-engineer learning workspace — 24-week curriculum map synced from Notion.
- [DSA Patterns guide](https://arumugamg.com/learn/dsa-patterns/): Every core DSA pattern with plain-English explanations, Python templates, and complexity tables.
- [Progress tracker](https://arumugamg.com/track/): Live learning-track status, synced from Notion.

## Agent integration

- [MCP server](https://github.com/arumugamtvm/portfolio/tree/main/mcp): A Model Context Protocol server (stdio) exposing get_profile, get_skills, get_projects, get_resume_text, and live get_github_repos. Run with `cd mcp && npm install && npm start`.

## Live on-page assistant (local AI)

- The homepage has a built-in chat that CONTROLS the page (navigate, switch theme, highlight, run commands) via a LOCAL Ollama model — privacy-first, runs entirely on the owner's machine, no cloud, no API keys, no telemetry.
- This is a LOCAL/owner capability: the deployed https://arumugamg.com site cannot reach a localhost Ollama server (Ollama's default CORS allows only localhost origins, and Chrome's Local Network Access gates public-to-localhost calls). This is NOT a mixed-content issue — http://localhost is a trustworthy loopback origin. Visitors/agents on the live site should use the structured sources above (profile.json, this file) and the on-page scripted guided tour.
- Recommended model: qwen3-coder:30b (tool-capable). Endpoint: http://localhost:11434. See CHAT.md to run it.
